items.title: Dune: Awakening's free Blood and Ice expansion swaps sand for snow on 1st December
items.en_title: Dune: Awakening's free Blood and Ice expansion swaps sand for snow on 1st December
items.en_oneliner: Dune: Awakening's free Blood and Ice expansion arrives December 1, swapping desert for a new icy map, a new destination for survival MMO players.

items.title: Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition launches 12th November and a demo is out tomorrow
items.en_title: Pikmin 4 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition launches 12th November and a demo is out tomorrow
items.en_oneliner: The Pikmin 4 Switch 2 edition launches November 12 with the new Dandori Academy mode, and the demo goes live a day earlier.

items.title: The Sunday Papers
items.en_oneliner: RPS Sunday Papers: a collection of the week's best writing in and around games, paired with the author's home renovation musings, good weekend slow reading.

items.title: PUBG live-action series in the works at Netflix, with Donald Glover set to direct and star
items.en_title: PUBG live-action series in the works at Netflix, with Donald Glover set to direct and star
items.en_oneliner: A PUBG live-action series will come to Netflix, with Donald Glover directing, writing, and starring, another case of game IP adaptation to film and TV worth watching.
